items.title: M1 · Divider
items.summary: Draw the divider from the paper and report the voltage at its output.
tasks: Type your name under the sheet before you start: your values depend on it.
Draw the circuit on the paper: VS = DC {VS} with R1 = {R1} above R2 = {R2}.
Name the junction between the resistors OUT, and ground the bottom of R2.
Set the analysis to Operating point and run it.
Enter the voltage at OUT, then press Submit exam answer once.

items.title: M2 · RC low-pass filter
items.summary: Draw the filter from the paper, sweep it, and report its corner frequency.
tasks: Type your name under the sheet before you start: your values depend on it.
Draw a series RC: VS (DC 0, AC 1) into R1 = {R1}, then C1 = {C1} to ground.
Name the input IN and the node across the capacitor OUT.
Sweep from 10 Hz to 1meg at 50 points per decade, probe OUT, and run it.
Enter the frequency where the output has fallen 3 dB, then press Submit exam answer once.
